_about: What each check tier runs (docs/process/qa-checklist.md 'When we check, and how deep'; Zafar, 9-10 Nov). The six tools in build/tools/tiers/ read only this file for their sizes, levels and checks; change a tier here, not in a tool. 'checks' places every check of docs/process/check-audit.md that is not already inside checks.mjs or a play-through: each names the tiers that run it, when (a regex over the changed files, 'always', or 'games:cook' / 'games:clinic' when such a game changed), and whether a failure blocks or only reports (blocks false: marked FIX in the audit, its fix not landed; 'fix' says which).

checks.what: the row probes (evidence.mjs): red then green; the judge's batch for Fable
checks.builtin: check-change (rows the diff or brief names), check-sprint (--sprint)

checks.what: chai against its frozen run (frozen.mjs --diff)
Cook's mount test (COOK-16: leaked listeners)
Cook's Kutchi leak bot (a browser; non-negotiable 4)
the parked modes' leak bots (snap, tidy, who, dress, monsoon, find)
checks.builtin: checks.mjs in every tier when their files change; check-publish runs checks.mjs --full (all of them)

checks.what: time and bytes to the first tap (loadtime.mjs; 20% growth fails)
checks.note: check-sprint runs it per changed Cook game inside the audit step

checks.what: per changed Cook game: panelcheck, labcheck played to the order, load time, its leak bot, voicegate, spkgap, lightfollow, faces, tapgate and pillcheck (chai only) (audit.mjs --only)
the side panel at each size and level (panelcheck.mjs)
the standard's rules against the saved runs (audit.mjs --standard; no browser): the gap list
the prototypes' first-time light (teachgate.mjs, SH-197)
one sheet per shared element changed, from every live page (kitsheet.mjs --after), for the judge
checks.note: makes pictures for the judge: never blocks

checks.what: beside chai (sidebyside.mjs) for a game on its new scene and art
checks.builtin: check-sprint, for each changed Cook game whose pictures changed (tiers.sprint.besideChai)
